description: Review the plan engine's task-DB and promote selected PlanTask rows into the user's backlog/. Drives export_to_backlog.ts — the only writer of backlog/tasks/*.md cards (graduate_group_docs.ts moves graduated comprehension docs alongside them), run deliberately by the human when graduating planned work.

flows.name: Plan task-DB rows → verified refactor epics in backlog/
flows.description: Review the plan task-DB, deep-investigate each change group against the real packages/core, consolidate linked groups into epics, stage a comprehension doc per cluster, and graduate the funded clusters into backlog/.
intentions: export_to_backlog.ts is the only writer of backlog/tasks/*.md cards; graduation is always a human decision, never run on the autonomous sweep.
A real export requires both --assignments and --write: the card body is always the architect's authored task_assignment.json, never the plan engine's cheap pre-investigation PlanTask.body.
The verdict.json file — not the sub-agent's returned prose — drives routing; a group whose verdict is permanent_limitation leaves the backlog pipeline and reroutes to classifier-author.
Only proposed rows export; a row already exported, or whose dedup_key a backlog card already carries, is dropped, so a re-run with the same arguments is a no-op.
Every selected row must be claimed by exactly one authored task's plan_task_ids, or the export errors — the architect's map must be complete.
The investigation is design-only: refactor-investigator reads packages/core but never writes it.
bypasses: consolidation (step 4) is skipped when only one investigated group remains on the backlog path

flows.name: Permanent-limitation group → staged registry classifier draft
flows.description: Route a group whose call relationship is fundamentally unknowable to static analysis to classifier-author, which stages a registry draft (draft_entry.json + check_<group>.ts) the human reviews and applies via reconcile-registry --stage.
intentions: A permanent-limitation group routes to classifier-author, never to a backlog card — its durable deliverable is a registry classifier.
prioritize and its classifier-author sub-agent never write registry.json; the agent stages a draft the human applies via reconcile-registry --stage.
The human is the final adjudicator of the is_permanent_limitation flag, not the flag itself; a mis-marked group is re-routed in either direction before dispatch.
A fixable bug misrouted here is caught by classifier-author's 'if fixable, stop — emit no draft' gate.
bypasses: consolidation, comprehension docs, and export (steps 4-7) do not run for permanent-limitation groups

stores.semantic_role: the plan engine's task-DB: one PlanTask row per proposed fix. prioritize reads candidate rows here to build change groups by fault_area; the export adapter flips claimed rows to exported through the plan writer, but prioritize itself never mints rows.

the user's backlog. export_to_backlog.ts (the pipeline's only writer of these cards) renders each funded cluster's epic and sub-tasks verbatim from the architect's task_assignment.json, stamps the source groups' dedup_key into plan_dedup_keys, and flips every claimed plan row to exported.

per-cluster comprehension doc staged in-repo (tracked, not gitignored) so the user opens it from their tree while ranking clusters. It stays uncommitted until graduation moves a funded cluster's doc beside its epic; an unfunded cluster's doc is deleted.

the graduated comprehension doc. graduate_group_docs.ts MOVES a funded cluster's backlog/docs/<slug>.comprehension.html here, sharing the epic's filename prefix so it sorts beside the epic card in folder views.

per-invocation investigation staging under a minted UTC-timestamp root: refactor_plan.md + verdict.json per group, reroutes.json, groups.json, consolidation.json + clusters/<slug>/consolidated_plan.md + task_assignment.json, run.json resume manifest, and export_summary_<slug>.json. Written by the sub-agents and orchestrator; the audit trail of each run.

per-group registry-draft staging: draft_entry.json (a complete KnownIssue with a builtin classifier), check_<group_id>.ts (the BuiltinCheckFn to place under packages/core), and REVIEW.md. classifier-author writes here and NEVER writes registry.json — the human applies the draft via reconcile-registry --stage.

sub_agents.multiplicity: one per fixable change group (rows with is_permanent_limitation:false); dispatched all in one message, capped at ~5 concurrent and drained in waves. disable-model-invocation:true.
one per invocation, reasoning across every investigated group's plan; skipped entirely when only one group was investigated. disable-model-invocation:true.
one per cluster in consolidation.json, rendering that cluster's plan into backlog/docs/<slug>.comprehension.html. disable-model-invocation:true.
one per confirmed (funded) cluster, dispatched in parallel; authors task_assignment.json. disable-model-invocation:true.
one per confirmed permanent-limitation group; stages a registry draft, never writes registry.json. disable-model-invocation:true.
